titles: Horror Story: My Doorbell Camera Records Tomorrow Night
Horror Story: The Figure on My Porch Is Me
Horror Story: Every Night at 3:12 My Doorbell Pings
Horror Story: What My Doorbell Camera Kept Recording
Scary Story: The Doorbell Camera Knows What Happens Next
description:
A night-shift nurse gets a doorbell camera alert at 3:12 every night, showing a hooded figure on her porch.
When she checks the date stamp on the recordings, she finds something that should be impossible.
A five-chapter narrated horror story.
